lines: Baat niklegi to phir door talak jayegi
couplets.en: Once word gets out, it will travel far.

lines: Log bewajah udaasi ka sabab poochhenge
couplets.en: For no reason at all, people will ask why you are sad.

lines: Yeh bhi poochhenge ke tum itni pareshaan kyun ho
couplets.en: They will ask, too, why you are so troubled.

lines: Ungliyaan uthengi sookhe hue baalon ki taraf
couplets.en: Fingers will point at your dry hair.

lines: Ek nazar dekhenge guzre hue saalon ki taraf
couplets.en: They will cast a glance back at the years gone by.

lines: Choodiyon par bhi kai tanz kiye jayenge
couplets.en: Even your bangles will draw a few barbs.

lines: Kaanpte haathon pe bhi fiqre kase jayenge
couplets.en: They will make remarks about your trembling hands, too.

lines: Log zaalim hain, har ek baat ka taana denge
couplets.en: People are cruel, and will turn every little thing into a taunt.

lines: Baaton baaton mein mera zikr bhi le aayenge
couplets.en: Somewhere in the conversation, they will bring up my name.

lines: Unki baaton ka zara sa bhi asar mat lena
couplets.en: Do not let a word they say get to you.

lines: Warna chehre ke taassur se samajh jayenge
couplets.en: Otherwise, they will read it in your face.

lines: Chaahe kuchh bhi ho, sawaalaat na karna unse
couplets.en: Whatever happens, ask them no questions.

lines: Mere baare mein koi baat na karna unse
couplets.en: Say nothing to them about me.

lines: Baat niklegi to phir door talak jayegi
couplets.en: Once word gets out, it will travel far.
